dimensions.prd_completeness: Required PRD.json sections are present and non-empty.
dimensions.task_artifact_traceability: Every task artifact has tasks and every task links back to PRD IDs.
dimensions.task_actionability: Tasks have acceptance criteria and verification commands.
dimensions.testability: Acceptance criteria and testing decisions are sufficient for automated checks.
dimensions.spec_kit_asset_readiness: The plugin bundles active Spec Kit planning scripts, templates, and workflow metadata needed for local handoff while implementation references remain downstream-only.
